latestChangelog: Add interactive target selection dropdown list in Shot Detect tab and fix manual target lock deselection bug.

history.changelog: Initial high-performance release with external player caching and optimized rendering loops.
Aimbot optimizations, cache scanning improvements, projectile prediction, adaptive smoothing, and mouse jitter fixes.
Improved wall checks (ignoring transparent boundaries/foliage/small details) and knock checks (incorporating Humanoid PlatformStand/Sit states and additional KO signatures).
Performance optimization to resolve FPS drops, rate-limit triggerbot, and fix mouse aimbot camera jitter.
Critically-damped spring physics mouse smoothing and prediction filtering to eliminate aimbot jitter and random hopping.
Fix mouse aim lock jitter with independent rate-limited time delta integration and sticky captured mouse detection.
Fix Smart Bone fallback prioritization override and correct spring-damper sensitivity math to prevent camera jumping.
Improve slider UI by restoring standard ImGui slider styling and adding double-click to input value editing.
Fix triggerbot local player filtering, exclude local player from triggerbot hitbox visuals, and correct mouse sensitivity scaling math under first person/mouse lock.
Fix aimbot smoothing wandering/flicking by resetting tracking states on target acquisition, implementing soft-saturation error mapping, and correct 1-to-1 mouse sensitivity feedback scaling.

Improve closest point precision using exact analytical 3D OBB distance minimization and client-relative unprojection. Enhance the hit part system with R6 prioritized fallbacks and closest visible part acquisition.
Add Auto Green (Hoopz) with dynamic distance-based delay. Improve silent aim activation checks by including mouse click and manual lock states.
Add Auto Aim (Hoopz) camera alignment and snapping with configurable smooth factor for perfect shooting trajectory coordination.
Completely remove Hoopz Auto Green and Auto Aim features.
Revert aimbot lock stabilization changes and retain semi-blatant smoothing speed.
Remove spring-damping physics camera and mouse smoothing, replacing it with standard easing-based smoothing.
Completely rewrite the aimbot tracking and smoothing logic using critically damped spring physics, adaptive smoothing, organic shaking, and randomized bone offsets.
Replace spring physics with standard LERP-based smoothing for natural glide velocity; completely remove easing-based snapping.

Modernize target lock system: dynamic Roblox mouse sensitivity scaling, robust calculated velocity tracking with EMA filtering, physics-accurate critically damped springs (Easing Style 12), and organic hand jitter shake.
Add interactive target selection dropdown list in Shot Detect tab and fix manual target lock deselection bug.
